page.title: Set up Nooch
page.purpose: Set up food rules, kitchen, and rhythm in four short steps — Your food, Your kitchen, Your rhythm, Ready — as a resumable draft that changes nothing until applied, with an Explore-first path that makes no fit claims.

priorities.statement: Each step asks only what it needs, with the current and remaining steps visible.
Diet presets show the exclusions they create, and allergies and exclusions stay explicit, separate, and editable.
Kitchen equipment uses the same tiles and scene as Kitchen, and choosing none is valid.
Ready summarizes the rules and how many meals fit, need review, or are excluded, computed by the planner's own eligibility.
Nothing becomes active until Apply; leaving keeps a resumable draft.
Explore first is allowed and says plainly that suggestions do not reflect unentered rules.

states.description: Step 1, Your food: diet approach, exclusions, allergies.
First read of the page's data; stable skeletons reserve the layout so nothing shifts on arrival, and no sample food is shown as saved data.
A write is in flight; the affected control shows a busy state and says why it is unavailable, and success appears only after the durable save.
The request failed; the reason and the next action are stated, pending edits are kept, and nothing is edited against a fake empty account.
Input was rejected; the offending field is identified next to it and every other edit is preserved.
The client cannot reach the API; cached data, locally pending actions, and server-confirmed saves are distinguished and unsupported actions say why.
No saved or curated meals exist yet, so Ready reports zero fits with Add a meal and Explore instead of an empty summary.
Some meals lack the evidence needed to judge them; Ready counts them as needs review rather than fits.
The saved draft is older than the active settings, which changed elsewhere; the differences are shown before Apply.
Step 2, Your kitchen: equipment tiles and scene.
Step 3, Your rhythm: budget, effort, variety, meal slots, and batch willingness.
Step 4, Ready: a summary with fits, needs-review, and excluded counts.
Ready finds no fitting meals; Add a meal and Adjust setup are offered and no rule is relaxed.
Applying would affect an existing plan; the conflicts are previewed first.
Returning to an unfinished setup restores the saved draft.
Closing with unsaved changes offers Keep editing or Discard.
The person chose to explore before setup; the unconfigured state is explained.

claims.statement: Continue, or Apply on Ready, is the one filled primary action; Back is secondary.
Setup values stay a labelled draft and do not affect planning until Apply.
A diet preset shows the exact groups it excludes.
Ready's counts come from the same eligibility service the planner uses.
Zero fitting meals are reported with next actions and no restriction is loosened.
Applying rules that affect an existing plan previews the conflicts first.
Choosing no equipment is valid and leads to assembly meals, never an implied microwave.
Explore first is available and the resulting state makes no fit claims.
Presets, chips, tiles, questions, Back, Continue, and Apply are keyboard reachable.
On phones each step is a full-screen panel with a compact step indicator and actions above the keyboard.
Light and Evening change palette and artwork only; the recipe, servings, dates, occurrences, layout, and actions are identical.
